dataset.name: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma (RC-PTCL)
dataset.description: Public GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq from the Refractory Cancers peripheral T-cell lymphoma project with an overall-survival contract.
dataset.cohort_context: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma in the RC-PTCL study. The project context is refractory cancer and must not be presented as an untreated population; the single source-coded recurrent profile is excluded from the 54-patient molecular population.
dataset.publication_citation: NCI Refractory Cancers Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma project

metadata.sample_selection_note: GDC leaves sample_type empty for all 55 RNA files. TRACE resolves it to Tumor only when tissue_type is exactly Tumor, excludes RC-B5D0-TBR1-A as the source-coded recurrence, then selects one file per patient deterministically.
metadata.excluded_material: The recurrent profile RC-B5D0-TBR1-A; any future record that changes the pinned 55-file/54-patient population stops the build.
metadata.treatment_note: The refractory-cancer study label indicates a treatment-context cohort. Exact prior therapy must be read from source metadata and is never inferred from the biospecimen label.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS uses the GDC diagnosis-anchored survival endpoint. Histology and prior-treatment fields require post-build coverage audit before promotion.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
